title: 咖啡店与外卖
goal: 能在咖啡店点单并说出要求（大小、冰热、少糖、换奶），听懂店员追问；会打电话点外卖。
tips: 点单句型：Can I get a ...? / I'll have a ..., please. 比 I want ... 更自然。
常见要求：iced 冰的，less sugar 少糖，oat milk 燕麦奶，extra shot 多加一份浓缩，no ice 去冰。
店员常问 For here or to go? 和 Can I get a name for the order?（报个名字，做好叫你）

exchanges.hear: Hi, what can I get for you?
exchanges.reply: Can I get a medium iced latte, please?

exchanges.hear: Would you like regular milk or oat milk?
